name: Capital Release Dynamics
status: Unvalidated invention; not installed or traded

mechanism.hypothesis: Uneven durable repricing after a sector moves from synchronized residual returns and low dispersion to decentralized residual strength; buy independently improving cash-generative firms, release capital only when conditional opportunity fades.
mechanism.observational_limit: Return synchronization and price/volume patterns are proxies; they do not identify investor positions or flows.

universe.selection: Monthly top 1000 by trailing 63-session median dollar volume, point-in-time listings/permanent IDs
universe.historical_requirement: Delistings, corporate actions and distributions included; current index members cannot substitute for historical universe.
universe.fundamental_eligibility: Positive trailing-four-quarter operating cash flow and latest annual gross profit/assets > 0 from original publicly available SEC filings; missing is ineligible for this research version, with coverage reported.

horizon.rebalance: Weekly, with daily close risk/exit monitoring
horizon.renewal: May renew at 20 sessions if conditional opportunity remains; no calendar profit trim

features.residual: e_i,u = l_i,u - beta_m,i,u-1*l_SPY,u - beta_s,i,u-1*(l_sector,u-l_SPY,u); fitted intercept not subtracted
features.stock_rank: Within point-in-time eligible sector, percentile of standardized 10-session residual sum; midpoint ties
features.dispersion: 5-session mean of daily sector MAD of residuals standardized by prior-day 63-session residual sigma
features.synchronization: lambda_max of 50%-identity-shrunk trailing-63 residual correlation matrix divided by contemporaneous N; no zero fill
features.compression: D percentile <= .20 AND K percentile >= .80 on at least 3 of prior20 sessions
features.release: Previous compression plus D percentile >= .60 and K percentile drops >= .20 versus t-10; duration10 sessions from first event, overlapping events cannot reset age

signal.states: Ten living states s=(release_flag, residual_rank_quintile), plus absorbing EXIT
signal.admissible_training_outcome: Transition/reward end by t-1; 20-session bias calibration labels must also mature before cutoff
signal.origin_weighting: Total weight1 per sector origin distributed among eligible stocks
signal.reward_units: 5-session SIMPLE total-return residual net of origin-frozen factor contributions while held; post-exit stock residual reward0
signal.forecast_equation: raw_a = basis(s_i)^T*(I+A_g+A_g^2+A_g^3)*b_g; additive simple-return reward score calibrated to20-session executable simple-return residual outcomes
signal.control: Rank-only forecast omitting release and synchronization
signal.sparse_state_policy: Release increment zero, unavailable for new CRD entries

uncertainty.se_rule: Max(bootstrap SE, absolute historical chronological-out-of-fold forecast bias)

signal.market_component: 25% trailing252 daily log mean +75% log(1.06)/252 daily; 6% is annual nominal simple-return prior; sector mean75% shrink zero; project factor exposure only while economically held, convert projected factor log return to simple and add calibrated residual return; forecast cash afterward
signal.calibration: Past chronological out-of-fold20-session executable-entry/exit/cash residual outcomes; ridge-shrink intercept/slope toward0/1, min100 distinct origin dates; monthly fit frozen next month
signal.origin_attrition: Every delisting, sector change and eligibility loss is retained as transition to EXIT; no survivor-only transition counts
signal.exit_labels: Next-session executable liquidation/legal recovery and subsequent cash; -100% simple-return loss for permanent zero recovery; suspension remains held until executable sale/legal resolution; unresolved payout is immature
signal.release_age_approximation: 11-state model omits release age; actual10-session event expiry remains exact; compare age-aware transition baseline
signal.conditional_market_exposure: Joint transition survival and observed within-block historical exit timing, not full20-session stock beta after EXIT

entry.all_thresholds: Unoptimized preregistration defaults; no historical result claimed

exit.drawdown_trigger_execution: Next-session reduction/liquidation, five-session monitoring cooldown; gaps can exceed trigger
exit.daily_evaluation: Completed close, queue next session; no hindsight intrabar trigger fill

portfolio.self_financing_equation: sum_i x_i+x_cash+C(x,w_minus)=1, where x are post-order asset dollars/pre-order equity and C is cost/pre-order equity
portfolio.ambiguity: Residual mean intervals a_hat +/-1.645*SE only; market premium is not systematically subtracted
portfolio.scenarios: 500 joint20-session paths from synchronized5-session trailing return blocks plus fitted transition exits; preserve joint shocks and explicit zero recovery; exp(L)-1 for living returns; match calibrated SIMPLE means by positive terminal gross-multiplier scaling preserving zero outcomes; reject target means below-100%
portfolio.terminal_cost_reserve: Stock terminal proceeds include expected sell cost in both proposed and hold alternatives; account ledger deducts actual executions only
portfolio.post_cost_normalization: All portfolio caps apply to x/(1-C)
portfolio.rounding: Whole shares; retain feasibility/cash after fee debit
portfolio.no_trade: Hold drifted portfolio if robust20-session log-terminal-wealth improvement after current costs and terminal liquidation reserves <= log(1.0002)
portfolio.cash_policy: Keep cash when no legal or sufficiently supported opportunity; no mandatory deployment or guarantee of benchmark outperformance
portfolio.cash_return: Observed net daily cash yield compounded for actual cash-held sessions
portfolio.covariance_units: 20-session simple-return covariance; annualized volatility scales20-session portfolio SD by sqrt(252/20)
portfolio.cvar_units: 5%-tail mean terminal loss fraction of initial equity; .10 penalty coefficient dimensionless

costs.model: Actual fees + estimated half spread + calibrated impact; charge traded notional
costs.tax_scope: Pretax research account; personal taxes are not modeled

timeline.feature_cutoff: Friday16:15 America/New_York after completed official bars and actual filing receipts
timeline.freeze: Features and monthly coefficients fixed for next-session execution
timeline.quote_reoptimization: Next trading session09:35 drifted holdings/quotes/costs update without signal change
timeline.unfilled: Expire at interval end; stale/missing quote means no fill
timeline.historical_execution: Bid/ask/impact/volume-constrained interval simulation, no next-close substitute

novel_contribution.claim: Proposed ordered compression→correlation-release→stock rank-ascent interaction; joint release/rank Markov reward forecast; cost-aware displacement based on fading conditional stock opportunities.
novel_contribution.bounds: Individual ingredients have prior art; global originality not established; no new theorem or tested return result.

prior_art.overlap: Dispersion-conditioned momentum; abstract checked, full subscriber methods not accessed

validation.primary_joint_hurdle: J=min(g_strategy-g_QQQ,g_strategy-g_SPY)>0 AND g_strategy>max(g_cash,0), where g is realized annualized compound logwealth; total returns, identical dates/initial capital, actual costs
validation.benchmark_allocation: Natural QQQ and SPY total-return accounts are primary; volatility/beta matched benchmark+cash accounts additional diagnostics
ablations: Release-age aggregation versus age-aware transition model
validation.inference: Calendar-month/date/issuer dependence;20-session purge and20-session embargo; complete variant register and multiplicity correction across5 inventions
validation.locked_history: Multiyear block covering several bull/bear/rebound regimes, not selected after seeing results
validation.forward: At least12 months frozen paper receipts before a claim of forward qualification

dependencies: Historical sector metadata and factor ETF series
Original timestamped SEC filings and fact revisions
Current and historical executable quotes/interval volume
Joint scenario generator and constrained objective solver
kill_conditions: Incremental release forecast lift nonpositive in two consecutive independent6-month evaluation blocks
Costed allocation underperforms equal-weight exact same signals
Normal execution costs exceed half conservative expected benefit
Point-in-time timing, total-return or executable-cost dependency cannot be verified
failure_regimes: Narrow mega-cap rally concentrated outside selected cohort
Synchronized sector liquidation despite apparent release
